parameters: harness: a fifth more of the proteome

invariants.description: throttle = clamp((ATP - ATP_floor)/(ATP_ref - ATP_floor), 0, 1); J_cap = build_capacity J_ref throttle R_reg; s_build = min(1, J_cap/J_demand_total) (exact up to the 1e-30 mol/s floor)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(throttle, np.clip((cyto__C_ATP - ATP_floor)/(ATP_ref - ATP_floor), 0, 1), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(J_cap, build_capacity*J_ref*throttle*R_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(s_build, np.where(J_demand_total > J_cap, (J_cap + J_eps)/(J_demand_total + J_eps), 1.0), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12)

invariants.description: the pools never spend more than synthesis can: J_build_total <= J_cap (relative 1e-9)
the ATP port takes exactly what the pools use: j_ATP = -J_ATP_total = -(J_keep_total + J_build_total) (exact; relative 1e-9 with pools)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(j_ATP_prot, -J_ATP_total, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ATP_total, J_keep_total + J_build_total, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

bc_sweep.rationale: synthesis capacity from below to well above the two pools' demand; the ATP floor over the range where the cytosol's falling ATP crosses it
